steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: So you're here as well, Vargo...?

steps.name: Vargo
steps.text: Are you implying my sense of smell is worse than yours?

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: What I mean is, we've found the right place—that thing is inside the ward.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Sending us wolves to search every nook and cranny of the landship just to find a little keepsake Lappland happened to misplace... do you not find it funny?

steps.name: Vargo
steps.text: Enough grumbling, Caesar.

steps.name: Vargo
steps.text: We agreed the pack leader has the power to issue any order.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: So let's finish this quickly.

steps.name: Vargo
steps.text: Is that... your Fang?

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: ...Red.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: (Snoring softly)

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: (Pained muttering)

steps.name: Vargo
steps.text: Lappland's scent...

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: From the dagger in Projekt Red's hands.

steps.name: Vargo
steps.text: How could Lappland's lost keepsake be your Fang's dagger?

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Hmph. Our alpha she may be, but the white wolf is ultimately still just a pup.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Hey, Zaaro.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: That cloud of dust there was just wild burdenbeasts trying to get out of Rhodes Island's way, no?

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: Is there a need to ask me when the barrens lie right before our eyes?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Patience, now.

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: Doesn't sound like something you'd say.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: A landship just happens to stray off course into the depths of the wastes, and brushes by those mysterious roaming beings just as we happen to be on the deck, just so we can say hello...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You know how much effort I've put into arranging this special meeting for you and your kind, so why rush me?

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: You didn't have to trouble yourself.

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: We could've gone to Lungmen, or Acahualla. The few kin over there are far easier to track down.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Haha. Zaaro, the wolfpack's becoming more human indeed.

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I mean, I could simply invite Texas's boss to listen to underground rap, or I could meet that Duck Lord at the gambling tables. Quite a few times I've done so in Siracusa.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: But they're a minority amongst the Beast Aristocrats, no?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Say your so-called 'crisis' is truly so terrible, yet your first move is to find your kin hiding within human society, and hold a meeting like mortals do?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Call the other wolves back. Your kin will come soon.

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: Caesar is still hunting your keepsake... wait, you didn't lose it, did you?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I never had a keepsake to begin with, Zaaro.

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: Then...

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: You intended for Caesar to meet the Fang she abandoned?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Haha, I didn't say that.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Grandma?

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: I see you, Grandma...

steps.name: Vargo
steps.text: She's asleep.

steps.name: Vargo
steps.text: All you did was to get closer and she trembles so much in her dreams... her fear of you has seeped into her bones.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Heh.

steps.name: Vargo
steps.text: A dreamland...

steps.name: Vargo
steps.text: Enough, Caesar. This is dull and distasteful. Just take the dagger and go.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: That dagger is my gift to Red.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: When she had just started to understand what was going on around her, I found a beast fang and taught her how to grind it down into the sharpest dagger ever made.

steps.name: Vargo
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: You still don't get it? Lappland made me come here on purpose.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Does she want me to take the dagger back? No. She wants me to eliminate the fear and pain in this human, to rid my influence from her.

steps.name: Vargo
steps.text: Hm, that doesn't seem like her style.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Helping a poor colleague out, or perhaps expressing goodwill to the pharmaceutical organization she affiliates herself with... it is not hard to guess her intentions.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Which is why, as I said before: Our alpha she may be, but the white wolf is ultimately still just a pup.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Wait here, Vargo. I'll finish this senseless 'mission' in the blink of an eye.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Red.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Grandma... it's really you...?

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Who else could it be...? Truly, a poor child you are.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Tsk. Operator Projekt Red, this is the fifth time you've been on my tail ever since I boarded this landship.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: The scent...

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: I smell something familiar, on you.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: If you mean the wolves' scent, there's more than one on me.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Grandma...

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Is Grandma here too?

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Did she ask you to replace me?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: It sounds like... you want to kill me?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: If the Doctor and your boss who loves hiding in smoke won't be investigating, I'd be glad for a little exercise.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: No... I don't want to fight you.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: I don't know how to explain... Grandma found you, and you'll become like me. In the end, you'll...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Haha, thank you for your concern.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You're trembling, Red.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Grandma, she said to me...

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: I am like the ones I killed.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: I was only—

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Only winning her an insipid victory.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: I listened to Grandma, and I didn't listen to Kal'tsit...

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: I did something wrong, and again, and again...

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: I am both a huntress and true wolf.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Who am I?

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: My heart feels so... messy.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: (Pained sobbing)

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Do you hate that wolf, Red?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Do you wish to forget her?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Fear not—we are on Rhodes Island. Your Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I'd be glad to help you.

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: That's it?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: That's it. How could I just ignore her while Kal'tsit's away from Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: Lappland, are you hoping I will praise your passion, or your kindness?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Zaaro, are you hoping I will take your words as flattery, or sarcasm?

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Grandma, where are you going this time?

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Grandma never left. I've been waiting for you to catch up to me.
The young red wolf subconsciously raises her foot, but quickly comes to her senses and ends up holding still.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Do not doubt me, child. Do you think there is still a need for me to fool you?

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Your doubt, your pain. I will answer them both.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Come over, to Grandma's side.
A familiar voice, gentle words. A slight breeze blows through grassland, scraping a faint fishy smell from the soil... it is very safe here.
As if nothing has changed at all.
For a long time.
In the end, the young wolf cannot help but to step forward.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Is this a dream?

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: A dream, and yet reality.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Follow me, Red.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Why the silence? You would always pepper me with questions whenever we reunited... even when you were unable to string proper words together.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: I know. You harbor hate in your heart, you blame me.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: You lied to me.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: I trust you. So you shouldn't have lied.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: 'Shouldn't', child? There can't be such a dull feeling between us.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: You've lied to me too after all, haven't you?

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: On Carnevale night. You did not kill Agnese's Fang. What was that whelp called again?

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: L-Lunacub.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: You stayed your hand, you wanted to test me.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Because...

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: The Signori dei Lupi may break their Fangs, but a she-beast will not abandon her children. She may swaddle them in lies, but pure relations made in the wastes will always stay strong.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Both Rhodes Islanders and that tailor... they do not understand the wastes, but you believed their words, and let a hole form in our relationship.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: The truth is no longer important, and the same goes for who wins or loses...

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: This is the humiliation Grandma ought to shoulder, and also your rightful punishment, my child.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: I remember this place...

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: I said before: this is a dream, and yet reality.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: The grass here... You taught me how to hide my scent and wait quietly for prey...

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: This tree... You taught me how to make traps and hide them under dead leaves...

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: That rock over there...

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: You used to sharpen that tooth on it, until it became the sharpest dagger.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Every forest, cave, and skeleton we've passed by... this is your history.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: You're taking me back...

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Where will we stop?

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: You will know in time.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Are you still thinking about our conversation earlier?

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: I must.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: My heart feels so... messy. I don't get it.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Truth be told, we Signori dei Lupi have played our game too many times to count, yet you have been my most special Fang.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Only you live and think like a true wolf, so much so that you will never manage to assimilate into the humans on this landship, no matter how long you stay here...

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: You are too pure. You are the truest wolf there is.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: The truest...

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: So, my child. Forget what I said earlier. Forget the hate and blame between us.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Because emotions like those are too complicated for you... you are not to blame.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: We're finally here.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Th-This is...

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Where we met. I found you abandoned in that grass nest over there. So heavy was the rain that night your cries were almost washed away.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: There is where our journey ends, and where everything began.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: I will burn that nest, and then, what we have just experienced will have never existed.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: I don't understand...

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: I'll forget Grandma?

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: I'll forget everything about Grandma?

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: You will forget the confusion, pain, and grief I have brought upon you, as if I'd never existed...

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: ...I won't have nightmares?

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: That's right. What a clever girl you are.
Silence.
The young red wolf lowers her head, her knuckles white from clenching her fists too hard. She says nothing, seemingly in the deepest throes of her pain.
The graceful Signora dei Lupi does not move any closer. She decides to give the wolf cub a little time, even if... her own patience has long since withered to near nothing.
Finally, the young wolf looks up.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Grandma, I don't want it.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Do you hate that wolf, Red?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Do you wish to forget her?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Fear not—we are on Rhodes Island. Your Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I'd be glad to help you.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: I don't know...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You don't know?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: That means you don't want to.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: I don't want to? No one's taught me how to deal with this...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You're on the mark, Projekt Red.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Your life is woven of betrayal and lies, and pain drives you to wish you could forget.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: But it's no use forgetting. Just like pulling out your tendons and bones, turning yourself into an empty shell... is that not a crueler form of violence?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You know the wilderness well. Nightmares will also help you to live.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Um...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Haha, an idea just came to me.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: I don't have to forget.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: You warned me, I remember your words...

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: I have to remember hate, to keep my eyes on my enemies, so I won't get lost, so I can keep my blade moving... so I can live on.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: I used to take revenge for you... revenge on enemies that never existed.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: I'll avenge myself now!
Red kicks up high into the air, a wolf's hunting technique.
In a blink, she slices the Signora dei Lupi in two.
The mysterious dark mist scatters as blood rains on Red, giving her a demonic demeanor.
Her hand shakes violently, as if she does not dare believe what she has just done... and she faints.
But just as quickly, the dark mist converges once more, and the Signora dei Lupi manifests before Red again.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Did the dreamland give you the audacity to act against me? Anything done here amounts to nothing.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Fine, if you don't wish to forget, then live on with all you know of me. Let the nightmares layer over one another, let pain stack on more pain.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: That's all well and good...

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: The old game is no more, but I do not trust Lappland as much as Zaaro and the others do, that she can bring us a new form of joy...

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: I shall leave you as a lasting mark of this era.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: But I dare say I will forget you in a blink, wolf cub.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: After all, you are no different from the other Fangs I have broken in the past.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Come out, Vargo. We should go. The stench here is unbearable.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: No... this scent. Something's wrong...

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Is this a trick of yours, Lappland?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Vargo, did I hear right, hmm? Caesar just questioned the alpha?

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Why is Red's scent on me?!

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Really? That can happen?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Let me think... what just happened...?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Red wounded you with her blade, and your blood spilled onto her...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Hahahaha. Could it be, you and your Fang switched scents?

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: That was just a dream I granted her!

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Burning it away?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Haha, what heavy rain we have here...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Are you hoping to rid yourself of that odor?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: It's no use, my dear Signora dei Lupi.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Agnese told me eons ago, when this land was only wild... The wolves roamed in their packs, exchanging scents to communicate with each other and mark your territories...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: It was how you hunted together, and how you hunted each other...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: There is no way to rid yourself of another wolf's scent on you, until the curtain falls on your life.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Red's dagger...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: That dagger is indeed a keepsake of mine... and I've bestowed an 'alpha's blessing' upon it.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: So it was you who taught Lappland, Agnese...

steps.name: Agnese
steps.text: I'm not the only one she asked. I had no idea what she was planning to do with the knowledge.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Oddio! I forgot one thing...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: The Signori dei Lupi are immortal.

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Caesar. It seems you have no choice but to continue your travels on this land wearing Red's scent.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Even though you've never looked your Fang in the eye, even though you've long since cast her away, her scent will forever remind you of her existence, and you will never forget her.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Because you will never die, and so it will never go.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: (Mournful howl)

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Of course, you can punish me at any time. It will only bring more fun to my new game.

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: Why do all this?

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: To do all this as an alpha just for a young friend of yours, to scheme and shame your own wolfpack like this?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Are you implying I did this only out of sympathy for Red?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Hmph. What a childish Signora dei Lupi.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Caesar, I did not humiliate you for Red alone.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Zaaro, Vargo, Agnese, and the few over there... I hope this will keep you all on your toes—

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: The wolfpack is indeed becoming more human.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: The barrens are vast, wild, chaotic. I don't care how cruel you treat humans or even your kin... this is simply how things are in the wilds.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: But Caesar, your cruelty toward your Fangs is just like that of humans.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Deceit, betrayal, whitewashing, warping her cognition, planting nightmares in her head... you play with the crudest forms of power, no?

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: (Sniffs)

steps.name: Caesar
steps.text: (Huffs helplessly)

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: All of you tell me, how that so-called 'crisis' draws near, and the wolfpack must contact more of your kind...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: From Sami's icefields to Bolívar's Black Flow, from Sargon's deserts to Iberia's salt flat... there are few Beast Aristocrats used to colluding with mortals.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: So of course, I shall prove this new wolfpack will be purer than ever before.

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: Hey, Lappland.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: They'll be here soon.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Time to leave this dreamland and let that Red kid enjoy a good night's sleep.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Let us return to the deck...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: My wolves, it's time for our appointment in the barrens.
